title: 12. Application, API & AI Security Testing
projectThread: AeroShield (v0.1 -> v1.0): Hardening AeroCart's API, checkout ledger, and AI support agent from an unguarded prototype into a Zero-Trust platform with BOLA/IDOR tenant enforcement, RFC 8725 JWT validation, SSRF socket guards, Stripe HMAC webhooks, OWASP LLM Top 10 prompt shields, and SARIF CI gates.
